title: G Major — One Sharp
body: G major is like C major with one change: the 7th note F becomes F#. A sharp (♯) raises any note by one semitone — one key to the right on the piano.

title: Spot the F#
caption: Notice F# in the scale (bar 2). Every F in G major is sharp — the key signature at the start of a piece tells you this automatically so you don't need individual ♯ symbols on every note.
